DID YOU KNOW?Asbuton Alam

ID Asbuton adalah aspal alam berupa batuan yang mengandung bitumen dan material mineral.

EN Asbuton is natural rock asphalt containing bitumen and mineral matter.

DID YOU KNOW?Sumber Geologi

ID Pulau Buton di Sulawesi Tenggara dikenal memiliki endapan aspal alam.

EN Buton Island in Southeast Sulawesi is known for natural asphalt deposits.

DID YOU KNOW?Karakter Deposit

ID Karakter deposit berbeda menurut lokasi; pemetaan dan sampling kadar bitumen sangat penting.

EN Deposit characteristics vary by location; bitumen mapping and sampling are essential.

DID YOU KNOW?Selective Mining

ID Penambangan selektif membantu menjaga konsistensi bahan baku yang masuk ke fasilitas pengolahan.

EN Selective mining helps maintain consistency in feed material entering the processing facility.

DID YOU KNOW?Crushing & Screening

ID Crushing dan screening mengendalikan ukuran material sebelum pengolahan berikutnya.

EN Crushing and screening control material size before subsequent processing stages.

DID YOU KNOW?Moisture Control

ID Kadar air perlu dikendalikan untuk menjaga stabilitas proses dan energi pengeringan.

EN Moisture needs control to stabilise processing and drying-energy requirements.

DID YOU KNOW?Laboratory Quality Control

ID Pengujian laboratorium membantu memverifikasi kadar bitumen dan karakteristik material tiap lot.

EN Laboratory testing helps verify bitumen content and material characteristics for each lot.

DID YOU KNOW?Asbuton Butir

ID Asbuton butir merupakan salah satu bentuk produk olahan yang harus memenuhi spesifikasi teknisnya.

EN Granular Asbuton is a processed product form that must meet applicable technical specifications.

DID YOU KNOW?Asbuton Pracampur

ID Produk pracampur memerlukan pengendalian homogenitas, komposisi, dan konsistensi antarbatch.

EN Pre-blended products require control of homogeneity, composition, and batch consistency.

DID YOU KNOW?CPHMA

ID CPHMA merupakan salah satu teknologi campuran beraspal berbasis Asbuton untuk aplikasi perkerasan.

EN CPHMA is an Asbuton-based asphalt mixture technology for pavement applications.

DID YOU KNOW?Plant O&M

ID Pemeliharaan crusher, dryer, conveyor, feeder, dan unit proses membantu mengurangi downtime.

EN Maintaining crushers, dryers, conveyors, feeders, and process units helps reduce downtime.

DID YOU KNOW?Packaging & Storage

ID Kelembapan, kontaminasi, pelabelan, dan rotasi stok perlu dikendalikan selama penyimpanan.

EN Moisture, contamination, labelling, and stock rotation must be controlled during storage.

DID YOU KNOW?Port & Multimodal Logistics

ID Perencanaan pelabuhan dan angkutan multimoda membantu menjaga kepastian pasokan antarpulau.

EN Port and multimodal transport planning helps maintain reliable inter-island supply.

DID YOU KNOW?AMP Integration

ID Feeding Asbuton pada AMP harus sesuai jenis produk, desain campuran, dan konfigurasi peralatan.

EN Asbuton feeding at an asphalt plant must match product type, mix design, and equipment configuration.

DID YOU KNOW?JMF & Road Performance

ID JMF dan pengujian lapangan membantu memastikan campuran, penghamparan, dan pemadatan sesuai spesifikasi proyek.

EN JMF and field testing help ensure the mix, paving, and compaction meet project specifications.

Integrated cement-plant management controlling raw-material quarries, crushing, raw milling, homogenisation, preheating, rotary kiln, clinker, cement milling, packing, and distribution.

DID YOU KNOW?Raw Materials

ID Bahan baku semen umumnya mencakup batu kapur, tanah liat, dan material korektif seperti pasir silika atau bijih besi.

EN Cement raw materials commonly include limestone, clay, and corrective materials such as silica sand or iron ore.

DID YOU KNOW?Quarry Planning

ID Rencana tambang menghubungkan kebutuhan kiln, kualitas cadangan, kapasitas alat, dan reklamasi.

EN Quarry plans connect kiln demand, reserve quality, equipment capacity, and rehabilitation.

DID YOU KNOW?Crushing

ID Crusher memperkecil ukuran batuan agar material dapat ditangani dan digiling secara efisien.

EN Crushers reduce rock size so material can be handled and ground efficiently.

DID YOU KNOW?Prehomogenisation

ID Penumpukan dan pengambilan material yang terencana membantu mengurangi variasi komposisi umpan.

EN Planned stacking and reclaiming help reduce variation in raw-material feed composition.

DID YOU KNOW?Raw Mill

ID Raw mill menggiling dan pada konfigurasi tertentu mengeringkan bahan baku menjadi raw meal.

EN The raw mill grinds and, in certain configurations, dries raw materials into raw meal.

DID YOU KNOW?Homogenising Silo

ID Silo homogenisasi membantu menstabilkan komposisi raw meal sebelum proses pembakaran.

EN A homogenising silo helps stabilise raw-meal composition before pyroprocessing.

DID YOU KNOW?Preheater & Precalciner

ID Preheater memanfaatkan gas panas proses untuk menaikkan temperatur umpan sebelum kiln.

EN The preheater uses process heat to raise feed temperature before the kiln.

DID YOU KNOW?Rotary Kiln

ID Rotary kiln menjadi unit utama pembentukan klinker melalui proses termal dan reaksi kimia.

EN The rotary kiln is the main unit for clinker formation through thermal processing and chemical reactions.

DID YOU KNOW?Clinker

ID Klinker adalah produk antara dari kiln yang selanjutnya digiling dan dicampur menjadi semen.

EN Clinker is an intermediate kiln product that is subsequently ground and blended into cement.

DID YOU KNOW?Clinker Cooler

ID Pendinginan klinker adalah tahap penting yang juga berhubungan dengan pemulihan panas proses.

EN Clinker cooling is an important stage that also interfaces with process heat recovery.

DID YOU KNOW?Cement Mill

ID Cement mill menggiling klinker dengan bahan tambahan sesuai formulasi produk semen.

EN The cement mill grinds clinker with additions according to the cement product formulation.

DID YOU KNOW?Product Quality

ID Laboratorium menguji komposisi dan sifat fisik produk agar konsisten dengan spesifikasi berlaku.

EN Laboratories test product composition and physical properties for consistency with applicable specifications.

DID YOU KNOW?Alternative Fuels

ID Bahan bakar alternatif dipertimbangkan melalui pemeriksaan mutu, kesesuaian proses, emisi, dan perizinan.

EN Alternative fuels are assessed through quality, process suitability, emissions, and permitting checks.

DID YOU KNOW?Waste Heat Recovery

ID Panas buang dari sistem kiln berpotensi digunakan untuk pengeringan bahan atau pembangkitan listrik.

EN Waste heat from the kiln system may be used for material drying or electricity generation.

DID YOU KNOW?Packing & Distribution

ID Silo, rotary packer, bulk loading, dan transportasi dikelola sebagai satu rantai distribusi.

EN Silos, rotary packers, bulk loading, and transport are managed as one distribution chain.

Cement mill & qualityClinker / gypsum / additions proportioning, grinding fineness, strength and product releaseRecipe, mill trend, laboratory certificate, batch and silo reconciliationMill throughput, kWh per tonne, product conformity, first-pass acceptance
Packing & distributionSilo integrity, packer calibration, bag weight, bulk loading, shipment traceabilityWeighing calibration, packing log, silo inventory, dispatch and customer complaintBag-weight conformity, packing rate, dispatch OTIF, damage and complaint rate
COMMON PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT

Shared KPI dictionary

Formula and target must be defined in the approved KPI register. The values below define measurement logic, not performance promises or universal benchmarks.

Asset availability

Available operating time ÷ planned operating time.

Preventive maintenance compliance

PM work orders completed on time ÷ PM work orders due.

First-pass quality acceptance

Lots accepted without rework ÷ lots tested.

Production yield

Saleable product output ÷ eligible process feed, with an agreed mass balance.

Energy intensity

Measured energy consumed ÷ tonnes of defined product output.

OTIF delivery

Orders delivered on time and in full ÷ total due orders.

Environmental compliance

Applicable monitoring and permit conditions met ÷ conditions assessed.

Corrective-action closure

Verified actions closed by due date ÷ actions due.

Mandatory management gates

  1. Gate 1 — Legal & Resource: land / mining rights, permits, resource quality, environmental and social screening.
  2. Gate 2 — Engineering & Procurement: design basis, technology selection, vendor qualification, CAPEX / OPEX, maintainability and HSE review.
  3. Gate 3 — Commissioning & Handover: acceptance testing, calibration, operator competence, SOP, spare parts and emergency readiness.
  4. Gate 4 — Operation & Assurance: production release, product conformity, maintenance, audit, environmental monitoring and cost reconciliation.
  5. Gate 5 — Continuous Improvement: KPI trend, loss analysis, incident learning, corrective actions, energy and resource efficiency.
Engineering note: KPI thresholds, process windows, product acceptance limits, emissions limits, and inspection frequency must be set from applicable regulations, approved technical standards, equipment OEM requirements, product specifications, permit conditions, and project contracts. This website is a management framework, not a substitute for engineering design or statutory approval.
MISSION-CRITICAL DIGITAL INFRASTRUCTURE · DATA CENTER · SATELLITE GROUND SEGMENT

Tier IV Data Center & Tier 4 Satellite Teleport System

Infrastruktur digital yang tangguh dibangun melalui fault tolerance, jalur komunikasi yang beragam, keamanan, kesiapan operasi, dan tata kelola yang terukur. Data center dan teleport satelit dapat dirancang untuk saling mendukung layanan mission-critical dari orbit hingga pengguna akhir.

Resilient digital infrastructure is built through fault tolerance, diverse communications paths, security, operational readiness, and measurable governance. Data centers and satellite teleports can work together to support mission-critical services from orbit to end users.

UPTIME INSTITUTE · TIER IVWTA · TIER 4 TELEPORTFAULT TOLERANCETT&C · UPLINK · DOWNLINKEND-TO-END RESILIENCE

Dua Sistem Tier yang Berbeda — Satu Ekosistem Resiliensi

Istilah “Tier IV” dan “Tier 4” digunakan pada dua program sertifikasi berbeda. Keduanya tidak saling menggantikan dan tidak otomatis memberikan satu sertifikasi gabungan.

🖥️
UPTIME INSTITUTE · DATA CENTER

Tier IV — Fault Tolerant

Uptime Tier IV mensyaratkan infrastruktur data center yang fault tolerant serta concurrently maintainable. Kegagalan satu komponen atau jalur distribusi tidak boleh mengganggu beban IT yang dilindungi.

Uptime Tier IV requires fault-tolerant and concurrently maintainable data center infrastructure. A single component failure or distribution-path interruption should not affect the protected IT load.

  • Jalur distribusi daya dan pendinginan dirancang tahan kegagalan.
  • Komponen kapasitas dan jalur dapat dipelihara secara terencana.
  • UPS, generator, switchgear, cooling, dan monitoring bekerja sebagai satu sistem.
  • Desain, fasilitas terbangun, serta operasi perlu diverifikasi sesuai tahapan sertifikasi.
📡
WORLD TELEPORT ASSOCIATION · GROUND SEGMENT

Tier 4 — Certified Teleport

WTA memiliki program sertifikasi teleport dengan empat tingkat. Penilaiannya mencakup fasilitas, infrastruktur teknis, dan prosedur operasi; Tier 4 merupakan tingkat tertinggi pada program tersebut.

WTA operates a four-level teleport certification program covering facilities, technical infrastructure, and operating procedures. Tier 4 is the highest level in that program.

  • Antena parabola, RF chain, modem, baseband, dan routing jaringan.
  • Uplink, downlink, Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C).
  • Daya, pendinginan, keamanan fisik/RF, dan jalur komunikasi redundan.
  • Operasi, pemeliharaan, pemantauan, dan respons gangguan.
Catatan penting tentang 99,995%: Angka ini sering digunakan sebagai ilustrasi benchmark ketersediaan Tier IV dan secara matematis setara sekitar 26,3 menit dalam 365 hari. Namun, Uptime Institute menyatakan Tier Standard tidak memberikan prediksi availability atau downtime tahunan untuk setiap Tier. Jadi 99,995% bukan jaminan uptime maupun definisi sertifikasi Tier IV.

BILINGUAL KNOWLEDGE SERIES · ID / EN

DID YOU KNOW? · 30 Facts on Tier IV Data Center & Tier 4 Satellite Teleport

Buka setiap kartu untuk membaca fakta singkat dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan English.

DID YOU KNOW?Tier IV pada standar Uptime berarti Fault Tolerant.Uptime Tier IV means Fault Tolerant.

Satu kegagalan peralatan atau gangguan satu jalur distribusi infrastruktur tidak boleh mengganggu beban IT yang dilindungi.

A single equipment failure or distribution-path interruption should not affect the protected IT load.

DID YOU KNOW?Tier IV juga harus Concurrently Maintainable.Tier IV is also Concurrently Maintainable.

Komponen kapasitas dan jalur distribusi dapat dikeluarkan untuk pemeliharaan terencana tanpa menghentikan beban IT.

Capacity components and distribution paths can be taken out for planned maintenance without stopping the IT load.

DID YOU KNOW?Tier IV dan Tier 4 Teleport bukan sertifikasi yang sama.Tier IV and Tier 4 Teleport are not the same certification.

Uptime Institute menilai infrastruktur data center, sedangkan WTA memiliki program sertifikasi tersendiri untuk fasilitas teleport dan operasinya.

Uptime Institute assesses data center infrastructure, while WTA has a separate certification program for teleport facilities and operations.

DID YOU KNOW?Uptime Tier Standard berorientasi pada hasil, bukan satu desain wajib.The Uptime Tier Standard is outcome-based, not one prescribed design.

Standar menetapkan hasil kinerja infrastruktur yang harus dipenuhi, bukan mewajibkan satu skema teknis tertentu.

The standard defines required infrastructure performance outcomes rather than prescribing one specific technical design.

DID YOU KNOW?2N dan 2N+1 adalah pendekatan redundansi yang umum, bukan satu-satunya bentuk Tier IV.2N and 2N+1 are common redundancy approaches, not the only Tier IV designs.

Arsitektur dinilai dari kemampuannya memenuhi kriteria fault tolerance dan maintainability, bukan sekadar label konfigurasi.

Architecture is assessed by its ability to meet fault-tolerance and maintainability criteria, not simply by its configuration label.

DID YOU KNOW?Angka 99,995% sering dipakai sebagai ilustrasi ketersediaan Tier IV.99.995% is often used as an illustrative Tier IV availability figure.

Secara matematis, 0,005% dari 365 hari setara sekitar 26,3 menit. Angka ini bukan jaminan uptime atau prediksi resmi dari Uptime Tier Standard.

Mathematically, 0.005% of 365 days is about 26.3 minutes. This is not an uptime guarantee or an official prediction from the Uptime Tier Standard.

DID YOU KNOW?Sertifikasi desain berbeda dengan verifikasi fasilitas yang sudah dibangun.Design certification differs from certification of a constructed facility.

Uptime Institute memiliki tahapan sertifikasi desain, fasilitas terbangun, dan keberlanjutan operasional.

Uptime Institute has certification stages for design documents, constructed facilities, and operational sustainability.

DID YOU KNOW?Keandalan data center bergantung pada desain sekaligus cara fasilitas dioperasikan.Data center reliability depends on both design and operations.

Prosedur, kompetensi tim, pemeliharaan, perubahan, dan respons insiden memengaruhi hasil layanan.

Procedures, team competency, maintenance, change management, and incident response affect service outcomes.

DID YOU KNOW?UPS membantu menjembatani gangguan pasokan listrik.A UPS helps bridge interruptions in utility power.

Uninterruptible Power Supply menyediakan daya sementara agar beban kritis tetap mendapat pasokan saat sumber utama terganggu.

An Uninterruptible Power Supply provides temporary power so critical loads remain supplied when the primary source is disrupted.

DID YOU KNOW?Generator cadangan mendukung pasokan listrik ketika utilitas gagal.Backup generators support power when utility supply fails.

Kesiapan bahan bakar, pemeliharaan, pengujian beban, dan prosedur start-up tetap menentukan keandalannya.

Fuel readiness, maintenance, load testing, and start-up procedures remain critical to reliability.

DID YOU KNOW?Redundansi distribusi listrik harus sampai ke beban IT.Power distribution redundancy must extend to the IT load.

Sumber daya cadangan tidak cukup apabila jalur menuju server tetap memiliki titik kegagalan tunggal.

Backup power sources are not enough if the path to the servers still contains a single point of failure.

DID YOU KNOW?Sistem pendinginan adalah bagian dari ketahanan data center.Cooling is part of data center resilience.

Kegagalan pengendalian temperatur dapat memicu penurunan performa atau penghentian perangkat IT.

Loss of temperature control can cause IT equipment performance degradation or shutdown.

DID YOU KNOW?Jalur pendinginan perlu diuji terhadap skenario kegagalan.Cooling paths must be tested against failure scenarios.

Desain redundan harus didukung pengujian, pemantauan, dan prosedur pemulihan yang teruji.

Redundant designs must be supported by testing, monitoring, and proven recovery procedures.

DID YOU KNOW?Fault tolerance berfokus pada kemampuan melewati satu kegagalan tanpa dampak ke beban IT.Fault tolerance focuses on surviving a single failure without impacting the IT load.

Pengujian harus memastikan kegagalan komponen atau jalur distribusi tidak memutus layanan IT yang dilindungi.

Testing should verify that component or distribution-path failures do not interrupt the protected IT service.

DID YOU KNOW?Sertifikasi Tier tidak otomatis menjamin aplikasi bebas gangguan.Tier certification does not automatically guarantee application availability.

Perangkat IT, perangkat lunak, jaringan eksternal, keamanan siber, dan proses bisnis juga dapat menjadi sumber gangguan.

IT equipment, software, external networks, cybersecurity, and business processes can also cause outages.

DID YOU KNOW?WTA memiliki empat tingkat sertifikasi teleport, dari Tier 1 sampai Tier 4.WTA has four teleport certification levels, from Tier 1 to Tier 4.

Setiap tingkat mencerminkan kriteria untuk fasilitas, infrastruktur teknis, dan prosedur operasi teleport.

Each level reflects criteria for teleport facilities, technical infrastructure, and operating procedures.

DID YOU KNOW?Sertifikasi WTA Tier 4 merupakan tingkat tertinggi dalam program teleport WTA.WTA Tier 4 is the highest level in WTA's teleport program.

Program ini membantu pelanggan menilai kualitas operasi dan kapabilitas layanan operator teleport.

The program helps customers assess the operational quality and service capabilities of teleport operators.

DID YOU KNOW?WTA Provisional Certification berbeda dari Full Certification.WTA Provisional Certification differs from Full Certification.

Sertifikasi provisional didasarkan pada evaluasi mandiri dan memiliki masa berlaku terbatas sebelum evaluasi ulang atau proses sertifikasi penuh.

Provisional certification is based on self-evaluation and has a limited term before reassessment or full certification.

DID YOU KNOW?WTA Full Certification melibatkan pemeriksaan independen.WTA Full Certification involves independent review.

Proses sertifikasi penuh mencakup validasi fasilitas dan data oleh auditor independen.

The full certification process includes independent validation of facility information and data.

DID YOU KNOW?Teleport adalah bagian dari segmen bumi dalam sistem komunikasi satelit.A teleport is part of the ground segment in a satellite communications system.

Teleport menghubungkan jaringan satelit dengan jaringan terestrial, pengguna, dan pusat data.

A teleport connects satellite networks with terrestrial networks, users, and data centers.

DID YOU KNOW?Uplink mengirim sinyal atau perintah dari bumi ke satelit.Uplink sends signals or commands from Earth to a satellite.

Perintah misi dan data komunikasi dikirim melalui jalur uplink sesuai sistem dan protokol yang digunakan.

Mission commands and communications data are sent over the uplink according to the system and protocols used.

DID YOU KNOW?Downlink membawa data dari satelit menuju stasiun bumi.Downlink carries data from a satellite to a ground station.

Data misi, telemetri, citra, dan informasi layanan dapat diterima melalui jalur downlink.

Mission data, telemetry, imagery, and service information can be received over the downlink.

DID YOU KNOW?TT&C berarti Telemetry, Tracking, and Command.TT&C stands for Telemetry, Tracking, and Command.

Fungsi ini mendukung pemantauan status wahana, pelacakan, dan pengiriman perintah ke satelit.

These functions support spacecraft status monitoring, tracking, and command transmission.

DID YOU KNOW?GEO, MEO, dan LEO adalah kategori orbit, bukan tingkat sertifikasi teleport.GEO, MEO, and LEO are orbit categories, not teleport certification levels.

Orbit berbeda memiliki karakteristik ketinggian, cakupan, latensi, dan kebutuhan jaringan yang berbeda.

Different orbits have different altitude, coverage, latency, and network requirements.

DID YOU KNOW?Jaringan serat optik dapat menjadi backhaul teleport ke data center dan PoP.Fiber networks can provide teleport backhaul to data centers and Points of Presence.

Integrasi RF, modem, IP, routing, dan backbone serat membentuk jalur layanan end-to-end.

Integration of RF, modems, IP, routing, and fiber backbones forms an end-to-end service path.

DID YOU KNOW?Keragaman jalur geografis membantu mengurangi risiko gangguan bersama.Geographic path diversity helps reduce shared-outage risks.

Jalur cadangan yang melewati lokasi, duct, atau infrastruktur berbeda dapat mengurangi common-mode failure.

Backup routes using different sites, ducts, or infrastructure can reduce common-mode failures.

DID YOU KNOW?Cuaca dapat memengaruhi kualitas link satelit.Weather can affect satellite link quality.

Hujan lebat dapat menyebabkan rain fade pada frekuensi tertentu sehingga link budget dan mitigasi perlu direncanakan.

Heavy rain can cause rain fade at certain frequencies, so link budgets and mitigations must be planned.

DID YOU KNOW?Ground segment membutuhkan keamanan fisik dan siber.The ground segment needs both physical and cyber security.

Kontrol akses, segmentasi jaringan, autentikasi, monitoring, dan respons insiden melindungi fasilitas serta layanan.

Access controls, network segmentation, authentication, monitoring, and incident response protect facilities and services.

DID YOU KNOW?Integrasi Tier IV data center dan Tier 4 teleport memperkuat resiliensi end-to-end, tetapi bukan satu sertifikasi gabungan.Combining a Tier IV data center and Tier 4 teleport strengthens end-to-end resilience, but does not create one combined certification.

Setiap fasilitas dan jaringan penghubung tetap memerlukan penilaian, pengujian, dan tata kelola masing-masing.

Each facility and connecting network still requires its own assessment, testing, and governance.

DID YOU KNOW?Direktori WTA mencantumkan fasilitas teleport Tier 4 di Indonesia.The WTA directory lists Tier 4 teleport facilities in Indonesia.

Direktori WTA dapat digunakan untuk memeriksa fasilitas yang tercatat, tetapi status sertifikasi harus diverifikasi kembali langsung pada direktori resmi.

The WTA directory can be used to check listed facilities, but certification status should be re-verified directly in the official directory.

Official Standards & Technical References Uptime Institute · Tier Certification Uptime Institute · Tier Classification Explained Uptime Institute · Tier Myths & Misconceptions WTA · Teleport Certification WTA · Certified Teleports Directory WTA · ABS Cikarang Tier 4 Announcement NASA · Communications & Ground Segment ETL Systems · Satellite Ground Infrastructure

Catatan: Sertifikasi hanya berlaku untuk fasilitas, cakupan, dan periode yang dinyatakan lembaga sertifikasi. Jangan menyebut fasilitas sebagai “Tier IV certified” atau “WTA Tier 4” tanpa memeriksa sertifikat dan direktori resmi terbaru. Ketersediaan layanan end-to-end juga dipengaruhi perangkat IT, jaringan, orbit, cuaca, operator, keamanan, dan prosedur pemulihan.
